content_sections.text: The selection process for TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026 involves shortlisting of applicants followed by a personal interview. Application Scrutiny: TMB will examine the submitted applications and supporting documents. Shortlisting: Eligible applicants will be shortlisted for the selection process. The bank's decision regarding eligibility, interview and selection will be final.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for registering online e-applications is 25/10/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application fee for TMB Specialist Officer (IT) posts?
faq.answer: The application fee is Nil for all candidates.

faq.question: Q3. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The job location and posting for all selected positions will be at Chennai, Tamilnadu.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted and called for a personal interview conducted through Direct or Video Conferencing.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be uploaded with the online application?
faq.answer: Applicants must upload self-attested photocopies of SSLC or Higher Secondary Mark Sheet/Transfer Certificate for age proof, Degree Certificate/s, experience certificates, relieving letter, and the last month's salary slip.
